easyPrerequisites: An opponent is unable to block and kill Burakos.
description:
Declare Burakos as an attacker, attacking an opponent unable to block and kill it.
Najeela and Burakos triggers.
Resolve the Najeela trigger, creating a 1/1 Warrior creature token that is tapped and attacking.
Resolve the Burakos trigger, creating five Treasure tokens and causing the defending opponent to lose 4 life.
Activate the five Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}.
Activate Najeela by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, untapping all attacking creatures, giving them trample, lifelink and haste, and gaining an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat.
